# SC1003: module-boundary-violation

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for module boundary violation, module boundary. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Inspect the module graph and change the dependency or scope declaration that triggered `module-boundary-violation` or `module-boundary`. Keep dependencies one-way and make the smallest shared contract explicit.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC1003` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC1003
@Module({ name: "ui", tags: ["type:ui"], imports: [DataModule] })
class UiModule {}
@Module({ name: "data", tags: ["type:data-access"] })
class DataModule {}
```
